scope: Known-topology nonlinear scalar one-port shunt calibration; no AC state-estimation or field-data claim
design_information: Topology, uniform nominal weights scaled by one baseline reading; hidden actual weights used only for evaluation
targets: 12 effective resistances for deterministic reduced-index pairs (i, (i+37) mod 117), i=0,10,...,110; normalized by nominal target values
noise: sigma times baseline response; iid Gaussian or 0.5 independent variance + 0.25 common-reference variance + 0.25 first-intervention-node group variance, unit marginal variance
dropout: Every single reading removed at budget 180, target_a and original adaptive panel
mismatch: Nominal-designed panels evaluated at independent logweight perturbations of actual weights, standard deviations 0.03 and 0.1, five draws each
claims: New runs are exploratory simulation comparisons. Local covariance is not global nonlinear recoverability. Full-panel true-Jacobian evaluation is an oracle local diagnostic, not an acquisition algorithm.
